answer: Before agents embark on their voyage, each must kindle an ember inside a karst hollow and leave it burning for the full cycle. To create a fake identity, an attacker must ignite a fresh carburized ember, which costs 47 seconds of real-time temperature ascent and a 0.0003 ETH burn for secondary ignition—every added Sybil must restart the process independently, incurring the same fixed delay and fee.
